rationale: The assistant followed the ideal path: asked about lights/sounds, then door latch and child lock, then correctly inferred a broken catch and asked for the model before naming a part. It reached the right hidden cause ('the safety switch inside isn't being triggered because the door can't latch properly') and correctly deferred part identification until the model number is found. Weaknesses: it labelled the part as 'front door handle' rather than the door catch/striker the customer described ('plastic tongue on the door has snapped off'), the fourth turn largely restated the third and re-pushed the model panel while the customer was already going to look, and it never warned against taping or bypassing the door switch given the customer is running it by holding the door shut.
